genius.notes: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank holds a Nebraska Digital Asset Depository Institution operating charter issued November 12, 2025. The current bank homepage identifies the bank as a wholly owned subsidiary of Telcoin, Inc., so the former parent-company d/b/a issuer attribution is removed. The June 15, 2026 terms and customer agreement identify the bank as eUSD issuer, describe transferable fixed-dollar tokens, segregated backing and eligible-account redemption, and distinguish third-party connected-bank deposits from eUSD purchases. The eUSD page discloses cash and cash-equivalent backing and promises regular reserve reports; the Digital Cash page promises monthly external-auditor attestations. No current report was linked on those reviewed pages. The June 23, 2026 announcement concerns planned GENIUS Act-compliant yield on eUSD, subject to regulatory requirements, without identifying an issuance-authorization route or PPSI filing. Retain no-public-authorization-found and unknown pathway. The Nebraska charter is not treated as GENIUS qualification. Treasury gives January 18, 2027 as the expected Act effective date. The optional enforcement finding is omitted because the scoped review does not establish comprehensive issuer action history.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The public OCC licensing table, Federal Register implementation materials, Nebraska sources and issuer pages reviewed on 2026-10-07 did not identify a GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, foreign registration or official pending GENIUS application for Telcoin Digital Asset Bank/eUSD. The Nebraska operating charter is confirmed separately. The issuer statement concerns planned compliant yield and does not establish an issuance authorization or application. This bounded public-source review does not rule out confidential or unindexed filings or determine Nebraska state-regime comparability.
